verdict.rationale: Typesense can be self-hosted on your own servers under GPL-3.0, with the complete API surface available, and you push your own data into it. That implies you control where indexed data lives and how long it stays, but the pack never documents deletion or retention mechanisms. Missing for 10: documented document/collection deletion APIs, retention or TTL controls, Typesense Cloud data-deletion and retention policies, and independent corroboration.
